headline: Police release suspect descriptions in violent Bridle Path home invasion that left 4 family members injured
briefing: Top stories right now: Police release suspect descriptions in violent Bridle Path home invasion that left 4 family members injured; Texas grand jury indicts ICE officer accused of running over man in Houston; and Ontario government completes bike lane removal on section of Bloor Street W.

keyDates.label: New U.S. tariffs take effect
keyDates.why: New 50% U.S. tariffs on some Canadian consumer goods start.

keyDates.label: U.S. midterm elections
keyDates.why: Control of Congress is at stake, with knock-on effects for trade and the Iran conflict.

keyDates.label: Israel certifies results
keyDates.why: Final Knesset results are due, after which President Herzog consults parties on who can form a government.

keyDates.label: U.S. October jobs report
keyDates.why: A strong report could push interest rates higher, which affects Canadian borrowing costs too.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.
